sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fractional CFO Advisory and Multicurrency Ledger Bookkeeping

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code tradition, with separate commercial courts and Conseil d'État administrative review)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Double Taxation Agreement (1984, as amended by Protocol of 2013)
France–China Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (2007, in force 2010)
France–Hong Kong SAR Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (1995, as applicable)
France–United States Double Taxation Convention (1994, as amended)
EU–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (in force 1 February 2019)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Book V, Title VI, Articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 and R.561-1 to R.561-63, as amended by Loi n° 2016-1691 of 5 December 2016 (loi Sapin II) and subsequent AMLD/AMLD4/AMLD5 transposition instruments; Code de commerce Articles L.123-28, R.123-29 and R.123-30 concerning the declaration of beneficial owners and the Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs; Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of valid passport or EU national ID card for each shareholder, manager, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the holder's country of origin / French notaire for French nationals
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the issuing state, or consular legalization where the state is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of Certificate of Good Standing / Extract from commercial or company register for any existing corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by French sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified criminal record extract or police clearance certificate for each proposed gérant (manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Casier Judiciaire National for French managers; competent judicial authority in the manager's country of residence for non-resident managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; accepted only if issued within 3 months before filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter or banker's identity confirmation evidencing source of funds for share capital payment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank at which the share capital or initial working funds are held
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank certification combined with Hague Apostille or consular legalization; notarization accepted as alternative

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of every non-French document in the pre-incorporation bundle, prepared by a traducteur assermenté
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator registered with a French Cour d'appel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No separate apostille on translation; sworn translator's certificate is attached to the apostilled or legalized source document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD/EDD screening against PEP lists applying the FATF and national French definition, the FICOV and TRACFIN guidance, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, French asset-freezing decisions issued by the Direction générale du Trésor, and, where USD clearing or US-linked payment rails are used, OFAC SDN screening. Enhanced due diligence is required for any foreign PEP, politically exposed family member, or closely associated person; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation must be retained for five years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by INPI; official registry database: Registre national des entreprises (RNE) searchable through data.inpi.fr; commercial court registry extracts available via Infogreffe
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The dénomination sociale must be expressed in Latin script and must not contravene French public policy or public order. A non-Latin source name must be transliterated into Latin characters; all mandatory statutory mentions in the articles of association (SARL, capital social, siège social, objet social) must be in French. The name must not be misleading as to the company's lawful object or legal form and must be distinguishable from prior registered corporate names and prior trademarks.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: banque / finance / établissement de crédit — requires prior authorization from ACPR or Conseil d'État as applicable
assurance / mutuelle / courtier / intermédiaire d'assurance — reserved to licensed insurance or intermediary entities
expert-comptable / comptable agréé — reserved to members of the Ordre des experts-comptables
avocat / notaire / huissier de justice / commissaire de justice — reserved to regulated legal professions
France / République / National / Officiel — likely to trigger refusal unless express ministerial authorization is obtained
Fonds commun de placement / Société de Bourse / société d'investissement — reserved terms under AMF approvals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The French system does not operate a true name-reservation registry; priority arises from the date of filing through the guichet unique. A negative availability certificate obtained from INPI/Infogreffe is indicative only and valid for about thirty days. If the registry or INPI rejects the proposed name, the applicant may refile a corrected name through the same portal without losing the initial priority date only where the filing package is rectifiable; otherwise a new filing and publication fees apply. A formal refusal of immatriculation may be challenged by summary proceedings before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce within one month of notification, under Article L.123-4 and R.123-72 of the Code de commerce. If the rejection is due to similarity with an earlier name or trademark, the applicant may obtain a written consent from the prior holder or file an express waiver of the conflicting element.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a low-risk virtual CFO advisory and bookkeeping services SARL, subject to a written contract with an approved commercial domiciliation provider (société de domiciliation) satisfying Article L.123-11-2 of the Code de commerce. A pure virtual mail-forwarding address is insufficient; the registered office must be in France, capable of receiving legal process, and physically accessible for registry verification. If the service extends to regulated accounting, as defined by the Ordinance of 19 September 1945, the manager must be registered with the Ordre des experts-comptables and the regulated professional address requirements apply separately.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, quantified at approximately 1-3% per annum for the first year of a professional-services SARL using a compliant domiciliation address. Registry and INPI verify submitted documents automatically on 100% of registrations and may request documentary proof of registered office; unannounced on-site inspections become materially more likely only if the tax administration or TRACFIN identifies substance indicators, fictitious domiciliation, or abnormal cash flows.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI official registration and legal security fee — immatriculation au Registre national des entreprises
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut national de la propriété industrielle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory official tariff published by INPI; includes the legal security contribution for the RNE registration.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registrar judicial fee — frais de greffe for creation of the SARL and RCS enrolment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce competent for the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory judicial fee scale fixed by decree pursuant to the Code de commerce; non-negotiable.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal announcement in a Journal d'annonces légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized legal gazette in the department of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Published per-line tariff of the selected legal gazette, subject to market competition.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-approved legal domiciliation agreement for the SARL registered office (first 12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for low-risk professional service clients with virtual office obligations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, consular legalization, and Hague Apostille bundle for foreign UBO, manager, and corporate shareholder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaries public and apostille authorities in each country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and public-sector consular fees of the respective competent authorities; no statutory US dollar rate; converted at prevailing exchange rate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation into French by a sworn translator for all non-French pre-incorporation documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator registered with the local Cour d'appel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per translated page or source word; no statutory tariff.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal fees for drafting SARL articles, management appointment, pre-incorporation due diligence, and UBO piercing file assembly
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate law firm engaged by the incorporator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing fixed-fee market benchmark for a standard professional-services SARL with non-resident UBO documents.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and French sanctions screening via professional databases and commercial registry extracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Legal and compliance technology data provider / commercial registry extract services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Pass-through database subscription and background-search charges; no statutory tariff.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (formation and operation of the SARL), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (corporate existence and pre-incorporation contracts), Articles R.223-1 to R.223-23 (registration evidence), and Decree No. 2023-217 on the single business formalities portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, with all submissions processed through the Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (ADSF) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts of the SARL accompanied by the M0 electronic declaration of formation filed on the single-window portal; completion is evidenced by issuance of the official Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SARL has no statutory minimum capital and may be formed with as little as EUR 1; under Article L.223-7 of the Code de commerce, cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% at incorporation, with the balance due within five years. Funds are wired into a blocked company-in-formation account and released only after RCS registration upon presentation of the Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founders hereby subscribe in full to the share capital set forth in the Articles of Association, each contribution being recorded in the share register and acknowledged as fully or partially paid in cash as certified by the bank's blocked-funds attestation. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office is fixed at [address] and the corporate object shall include outsourced virtual CFO advisory, management accounting, and bookkeeping services. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name of First Manager] is appointed first statutory manager (gérant) for the term stipulated in the Articles, with the broadest powers toward third parties to bind the company, to open bank accounts, and to execute all filings. All powers are expressly granted to complete registration formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability review and drafting of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) online databases and Infogreffe national RCS search interface (data.inpi.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run availability searches for the company name, domain names, and conflicting trademarks on data.inpi.fr and Infogreffe; if the name is free, draft the Statuts in French (with optional English translation) containing the legal form, duration, share capital, corporate object (fractional CFO, bookkeeping, management advisory), registered office, distribution of shares, and powers of the gérant, while verifying compliance with Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 of the Code de commerce.
required_dossiers: Optional trademark application receipt where name protection is required
Passport or identity card of each shareholder
Proof of residential address of each shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing prior right, select a new distinctive name and amend the Statuts; the drafting counsel issues a clean revised draft before the capital deposit phase, so no registry query arises at this stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked company-in-formation account and payment of share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed credit institution chosen by the founders; in case of refusal, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations acts as the residual depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a transitory account under the name 'SARL [Name] en formation'; deposit the subscribed cash capital by wire; obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds certifying that the amount is blocked, the identity of the depositors, and that the statutory 20% minimum cash payment under Article L.223-7 has been satisfied; the capital remains blocked until RCS registration, after which the bank releases it against the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Proof of address of each shareholder
Instructions letter signed by the future gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the file, the shareholders deposit the capital with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; if the attestation contains coordinates errors, the bank re-issues a corrected attestation free of charge, and the corrected document accompanies the M0 filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the statutory legal announcement (annonce légale) in an approved journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) accredited in the département of the registered office under Article L.223-1 of the Code de commerce and ministerial decree
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the text of the legal announcement stating the corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office address, name of the gérant, and the RCS registry where registration will be applied for; ensure the text matches the Statuts; the JAL publishes the announcement and issues the attestation de parution attached to the M0 file; the announcement is also transmitted digitally to the official legal-notices service.
required_dossiers: Completed legal notice wording sheet signed by the founder or gérant
Invoice/payment receipt for the publication tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL detects inconsistencies with the Statuts, a corrected legal notice (rectificatif) must be published and a new attestation obtained; registry practice accepts the rectificatif when lodged together with the original announcement within the same filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the formation dossier on the single window and RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by ADSF, with transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for entry in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the portal, choose the creation of a SARL with activity code ISIC 6920, complete the M0 declaration, upload all attesting documents, certify the authenticity of signatures, pay the registration fees and taxes online, and track the file; after successful examination, the greffe issues the Kbis extract constituting conclusive proof of legal existence; data is simultaneously transmitted to INSEE, tax, and social administrations.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts (or their certified copy when executed before a notary)
Declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
Individual criminal-record declaration of the gérant (BNI)
Proof of authorized occupation of the registered office (lease, domiciliation contract, or property title)
Payment receipt of registry duties and taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe sends a demand for supplementary information, the representative has 15 days to upload the missing pieces through the portal; in case of full rejection, the statutory defects are cured and the dossier is resubmitted using the same attestations if still valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration formalities, Kbis verification, and operational governance setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) for registry data; INSEE for statistical codes; CNIL for data protection registration; professional insurers and the company bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the Kbis extract from data.inpi.fr and verify the name, legal form, capital, registered office, and officers; open the permanent operating bank account and present the Kbis; subscribe professional liability and cyber-risk coverage; arrange CNIL data-processing registration where client data are processed; execute the delegation-of-powers and corporate documents confirming the governance decisions taken in the first board resolution; update the RCS without delay for any change of office, manager, or capital.
required_dossiers: CNIL registration receipt or exemption declaration
Identity and address proof of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis contains mistakes, a written request for rectification is filed with the greffe; the greffe corrects the entry within days without requiring re-publication; changes of beneficial owners are declared via the supplementary portal procedure within one month.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ordre des Experts-Comptables et des Comptables Agréés (Conseil régional de l'Ordre) for regulated accounting and bookkeeping services; Direction Générale des Entreprises (DGE) as sector policy authority; local Préfecture and DREAL for physical and environmental compliance of leased premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Inscription au tableau de l'Ordre des Experts-Comptables (regulated registration for statutory accounting and bookkeeping services); where the mandate is limited to pure fractional CFO advisory and management consultancy, the unregulated consultancy regime applies without a sectoral permit, subject to holding an EORI number for cross-border EU services and a professional indemnity insurance certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires — Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) of the registered office region, together with the municipal sanitation authority for water discharge matters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is a pure office/tertiary service (ISIC 6920) and does not fall within the nomenclature of installations classées pour la protection de l'environnement (ICPE); a full EIA report or simplified environmental registration is not exigible; permits are limited to local waste-collection and occupancy declarations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: sanitary discharges only to municipal sewer, meeting the local règlement d'assainissement limits (BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, TSS ≤ 300 mg/L where applicable). Emissions: no VOC, combustion, or particulate sources beyond space-heating equipment complying with French heating performance codes. Waste: e-waste (DEEE), batteries, toners, and cardboard must be sorted and recovered through registered channels under the AGEC law (Article L.541-10, Code de l'environnement); the premises must maintain a waste register if annual thresholds are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: if the registered office is open to clients, it qualifies as an Établissement Recevant du Public (ERP) of the 5th category, requiring a building safety assessment and periodic commission de sécurité visits with an attestation of fire compliance; purely administrative staff offices must satisfy the Code du travail fire and evacuation rules. Electrical: a Consuel conformity certificate is required for any new electrical installation. Occupational health and safety: a document unique d'évaluation des risques (DUERP) must be prepared and updated; the workplace must pass the preventive inspection requirements practised by Carsat and the Inspection du Travail where staff are employed, including ergonomic, emergency-exit, and shared-office checks.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), operating through the Impôts.gouv.fr portal and the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-established entities must file an economic activity registration through the Guichet Unique; INSEE issues the SIREN/SIRET identifier. For VAT purposes, DGFiP issues a French intra-Community VAT number (FR+11 digits) based on the registration dossier. Non-EU entities without a French permanent establishment must appoint an approved individual tax representative for VAT registration and compliance; EU entities may register directly.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or entity classification election exists in France. A SARL may elect pass-through income tax treatment under CGI Article 239 if it has fewer than 50 individual members and is a family-type or closely held SARL; otherwise it is subject to corporate income tax (IS). French groups may elect tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI to offset taxable results within a 95%-owned subgroup. France applies anti-hybrid rules implementing ATAD; no hybrid mismatch election is available for outward payments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 36,800 annual taxable turnover for service providers (or EUR 91,900 for goods traders) under the VAT franchise thresholds; however, a French SARL engaged in outsourcing services becomes a taxable person from its first taxable transaction if it supplies services to foreign recipients or exercises an opt-in. For non-established suppliers, no registration threshold applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing is phased in under Ordinance 2021-1190: large enterprises from 1 September 2026, VAT taxable persons including SMEs/VSEs from 1 September 2027. Invoices must circulate in structured electronic format through platforms ('plateformes de dématérialisation partenaires') connected to the Public Billing Portal (PPF) API, with transaction data reported to DGFiP for clearance. B2C cross-border supplies require e-reporting. Mandatory 'digital stamping' is not used; B2G invoices continue via Chorus Pro with API clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported physically outside the EU may be zero-rated (0% VAT with input VAT deduction) provided the exporter proves removal from EU territory within 90 days and holds transport/export documentation per CGI Article 74 of Annex III. Services supplied by a French SARL to a business customer established outside the EU for 'offshore' or B2B services are outside the scope of French VAT under Article 259-1 2° CGI, and are not subject to French VAT; this outcome requires proof of the customer's foreign taxable status. B2C e-services to non-EU consumers are also outside French VAT when the consumer's residence is outside the EU.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/EX1) verified by French customs
Transport document (Bill of Lading, CMR, or Air Waybill) proving physical exit from the EU
Commercial invoice and contract of sale
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer confirmation evidencing foreign currency settlement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If export zero-rating is abused or substantiation fails, DGFiP recovers the undeclared VAT, applies late interest, and imposes fines: 40% of understatements for deliberate non-disclosure, 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres, and up to 10% in the case of use of legal avoidance schemes ('abus de droit'), together with possible criminal penalties for tax evasion (Article 1741 CGI) and joint liability of the tax representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, acting jointly with the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Recovery, under the Code monétaire et financier (CMF) Articles L.151-1 et seq. and Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible for current and capital-account transactions within the EU/EEA without prior exchange-control authorization; France has abolished the dual FX market, exchange quotas, and general authorization requirements. Residual convertibility constraints are limited to (i) EU sanctions regimes, (ii) counter-measures against FATF/CTRI non-cooperative jurisdictions under CMF Article L.561-2, and (iii) statistical surveillance: any transfer from or to a non-resident exceeding EUR 15,000 must be declared to the DG Trésor via the credit institution on the Déclaration de Change (DR/FC) form. Profit remittance by a French SARL is unrestricted at FX level; however, dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are subject to withholding tax at 12.8% under the Prélèvement Forfaitaire Unique, reduced to 0% for EU corporate shareholders holding at least 10% for more than 24 months pursuant to the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive 2011/96/EU, and further reduced by applicable double-tax treaties for most non-EU jurisdictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds and no statutory conversion ratio for export receipts since the 1990 liberalisation and the abolition of the obligation de cession. Two residual obligations apply to a French SARL: (i) repatriation — export receivables must be collected within the contractual payment maturity and credited either to a euro account or to a certificated foreign-currency account (compte de devises) with a French or EU-authorised credit institution; (ii) reporting — any receipt from a non-resident exceeding EUR 15,000 triggers a balance-of-payments (BOP) statistical declaration by the intermediary under CMF Articles R.152-1 and R.152-4. Non-collection beyond 30 days following the agreed settlement date is typically treated by tax and customs auditors as a presumptive indicator of export-invoicing or transfer-pricing irregularities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte de blocage) + Operational Account
Operational Account + Foreign-Currency Account (compte de devises)
Operational Account + FX Hedging Line (salle des marchés)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. / Crédit Agricole CIB

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Account (GBP/USD/HKD) for cross-border CFO-client settlements

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: CIC (Crédit Industriel et Commercial S.A., Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High viability as a settlement overlay, but not as the primary treasury anchor. Qonto and Shine are ACPR-authorised payment institutions in France; Wise Business, Revolut Business, and Payoneer operate as EU/UK EMIs passporting into France; Stripe provides card acquiring and funds-settlement infrastructure. Legal constraints: EMIs are not credit institutions, they cannot take deposits in the prudential sense, they cannot grant credit without a separate credit-institution licence, and e-money balances are not guaranteed by the French deposit guarantee fund (FGDR). For an ISIC 6920 virtual CFO business, use the fintech rail for client-fee collection and inexpensive subcontractor disbursements, while maintaining a tier-1 French bank account as the substance-holding and escrow anchor; high-risk non-EU corridors (US LLCs, HKD entities) should be processed through the tier-1 bank because inbound transfers from EMI aggregators trigger enhanced due diligence in subsequent transactions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is permitted when the gérant (director) is a French or EU resident, using an eIDAS-compliant electronic identification and video verification pursuant to CMF Article L.561-5 and ACPR guidance. A physical in-branch interview is effectively mandatory where the beneficial owner (UBO) is a non-EU/non-EEA resident: tier-1 banks require the physical production or certified hoographical copy of an apostilled passport, a notarised UBO resolution, a French address proof, and typically an in-person compliance meeting at a Paris branch. Non-resident corporate UBOs without an EU-established parent will be rejected unless the SARL appoints a French tax representative and proves economic substance through lease deeds, payroll, and client contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Licensing ambiguity: the description 'Virtual CFO / Outsourced Bookkeeping' overlaps with the regulated profession of expert-comptable (Ordre des Experts-Comptables), causing banks to classify the SARL as high-risk and to request evidence of the legal monopoly or audit-liability insurance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) a reasoned legal opinion from a French avocat classifying the activity as management advisory (conseil en gestion) rather than statutory accounting, or, if full bookkeeping is rendered, the OEC registration certificate; (2) the SARL's SIREN registration with APE code 6920Z; (3) professional indemnity insurance (RC Pro) policy; (4) client engagement letters explicitly excluding statutory audit and tax-certification services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible remote service model with minimal physical footprint and a single-man management layer, flagged as shell-risk and as non-alignment between declared turnover and demonstrable operating capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three months of payroll records (3+ employees) or formal subcontractor contracts with operational deliverables; an office lease with utility receipts; client-scale board packs and reporting schedules demonstrating deliverables; full Stripe/Wise transaction histories; the prior-year corporate tax return and VAT return certified by a registered accountant; and management accounts produced by the same accounting practice that audits the SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency cross-border micro-credits from payment aggregators (Stripe/Wise) with underlying clients located in non-EU jurisdictions, exhibiting pay-through or money-mule typologies under French anti-money-laundering guidelines.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-client wallet mapping identifying the invoice, the service agreement, and the delivery evidence for each inbound credit; a formal AML/CTF compliance manual applicable to the SARL under the Fifth Anti-Money-Laundering Directive; a client-risk register with CDD files for every UBO; and a sworn statement confirming that no client funds are held, controlled, or transmitted by the SARL (no mandat accounts or escrow arrangements).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership by a non-resident shareholder situated in a FATF grey-listed or CTRI non-cooperative jurisdiction, activating enhanced due diligence under CMF Articles L.561-5 and R.561-5-1.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) filing receipt from the commercial registry; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements for the UBO supported by bank references; apostilled copies of identity and tax-residency certificates; evidence of the SARL's French tax filings and payment of corporate income tax and VAT with an absence of enforcement actions; and a written memorandum explaining the commercial rationale for the French entity and the non-resident ownership structure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders may fund the SARL through a capital increase (augmentation de capital) or a shareholder current account (apport en compte courant d'associés). The compliant routing is a SWIFT MT103 wire from the investing entity to the SARL's IBAN in France with ISO 20022 purpose code 'CAPC' (Capital Increase) or 'FINP' (Financing of an Undertaking), quoting the SARL's SIREN and the legal title of the operation; the credit institution attaches the Banque de France BOP motive code 'Investissement direct - apport de fonds' (IV01) to the DR/FC declaration. For any direct investment in France by a non-EU resident exceeding EUR 15,000, the beneficiary must file a Déclaration d'Investissement Direct to the Banque de France (via Telerec) within 20 business days. The corporate-law dossier supporting the credit must include the duly signed minutes (PV d'assemblée générale) registering the capital increase, the subscription certificate, and the bank attestation of deposit or blockage of funds; if the inbound wire lacks a matching legal event, the funds will be re-characterised by French tax authorities as a deemed shareholder loan with potential interest-computation consequences.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For a virtual CFO entity, outbound clearing is predominantly services-based: (1) EU/EEA suppliers and subcontractors are settled via SEPA Credit Transfer (instant or one-day) using IBAN-to-IBAN with purpose codes 'SERI' or 'SUPP'; (2) non-EUR obligations (USD, GBP, CHF software subscriptions, foreign contractors) are executed via SWIFT MT103 with an MT202 cover, quoting the invoice numbers and ISO 20022 purpose code 'SURN' (Services), accompanied by a compliant economic-substance narrative to prevent false-positive sanctions hits; (3) if the scope later includes physical goods, high-value orders should use Documentary Collections (D/P at sight) or an irrevocable confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 issued by the tier-1 French bank; (4) FX conversion between euro and foreign currency is transacted at the bank's dealing desk at spot or a negotiated margin, with confirmation on SWIFT MT300; the multicurrency ledger must record both the original currency and the euro-equivalent value in accordance with the accounting standards applicable to an ISIC 6920 activities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward (change à terme ferme) on EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and EUR/CHF — committed OTC contracts with the tier-1 bank up to 12-month maturity, documented against the SARL's sales invoices and order backlog.

Vanilla FX Options (options de change) on EUR/USD — purchased or collared, booked under the ISDA 2002 or the French FBF (Fédération Bancaire Française) Master Agreement, with premiums disclosed in the corporate tax file.

Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) — permitted solely for covered exposures in non-deliverable currencies (e.g., HKD/EUR) with an investment-grade bank, contract settlement referencing a published ECB or WM/Reuters spot rate, no physical delivery, and statistical reporting to the DG Trésor.

Cross-Currency Swap (swap de change) — EUR/USD swap converting a USD capital injection or USD revenue stream into fixed-term euro cashflows over a 1-to-3-year horizon, used for financing software capex or acquiring a European subcontractor; subject to EMIR reporting and the FBF master- agreement framework.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual approval of statutory financial statements by partners (Assemblée Générale Ordinaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate record (Registre des délibérations); no external authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end (Art. L.223-26/L.232-1 Code de commerce); calendar-year companies by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Any partner may petition the Commercial Court to compel the gérant to convene; persistent failure exposes the gérant to civil liability and blocks lawful dividend distributions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of approved annual accounts (comptes annuels) with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce via INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of partner approval, and in all events within seven months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fine up to €3,000 for a legal person (Art. L.241-4-1), court-ordered astreinte, and risk of administrative strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax (IS) return — liasse fiscale Form 2065-SD plus annexes 2052–2059
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via EDI/EFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year company: 3 May (paper) or 15 May (EDI); off-calendar year: within three months of fiscal close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-filing surcharge; 40% if unfiled within 30 days of formal notice; 80% for concealed activity; monthly late interest at 0.20%

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VAT returns — monthly Form CA3 (réel normal) or annual Form CA12 (réel simplifié) with interim instalments
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly CA3 due by the 19th of the following month; annual CA12 by 3 May (paper)/15 May (EDI) with interim payments on 15 July and 15 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-declaration surcharge 5%–40% plus 0.20% monthly interest; suspension of VAT credit repayment until filing is regularized

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) — annual business property levy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Avis d'imposition issued in October; payment due in full by 15 December of the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10%–40% late-payment penalties, 0.20% monthly interest, and collection by public distraint if unpaid

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP — obligation abolished by Loi de finances 2024
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable from fiscal year 2024 onward (nil obligation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No penalty applicable (contribution and its declaration are abolished)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Déclaration Sociale Nominative (DSN) — social charge declarations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly, due by the 5th day of month M+1; absence-of-payroll statement required only when no salaries are paid
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: €55 flat fine per late or omitted statement plus €55 per omitted employee; 3% of social contributions after five days of delay; 5–10% for repeated violations

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) mandatory when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded for two consecutive fiscal years: total balance sheet > €5,000,000; net turnover > €10,000,000; average workforce > 50 employees (thresholds raised by Ord. n°2024-1075, effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025). Below these thresholds, audit is optional unless shareholders representing ≥10% of capital so request or group/public-interest provisions apply.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général — ANC Regulation 2014-03); IFRS mandatory only for consolidated group accounts; statutory statements in EUR; structured electronic format (XHTML/XBRL) required where mandated by size.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Event-driven, not annual: beneficial-owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) is filed at formation and updated at the RCS within 30 days of any modification, including any share transfer altering ownership of 25% of capital or effective control; the annual accounts deposit triggers a registry consistency check of the RBE data; public access to the RBE has been suspended since the Conseil d'État decision of 29 December 2023.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des délibérations des organes sociaux (shareholders' minute book, coté et paraphé)
Registre des mouvements de titres (share-transfer ledger and official register of members)
Registre de présence et pouvoirs des associés (attendance and proxy register for meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400–1,500 per year for a professional domiciliation at an authorized business centre, including mail forwarding and legal address services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,500–12,000 per year for an opt-in regulatory audit; US$12,000–30,000 per year where a mandatory commissaire aux comptes is appointed

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs; R&D tax credit (CIR) at 30%; innovation tax credit (CII) at 20%; loss carryback up to 3 years and €1,000,000
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_rule: Available indefinitely under Art. 209 CGI; annual offset limited to €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding that amount

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Cerfa n° 2065-SD and full liasse fiscale (sets 2050–2059) filed electronically via EFI/Téléprocédure on impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual with four quarterly advance instalments and one balance settlement
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For FY ended 31 Dec: due by the second working day after 1 May (typically 3 or 4 May). For other FY-ends: due within 3 months and 15 days of fiscal year-end for e-filers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover and other operating income worldwide, net of trade discounts
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross revenue booked via Stripe/Wise; reconcile with VAT returns; include all currency gains and losses

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current operating profit after financial income and expenses; includes fractional CFO advisory and multicurrency ledger service fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border management or service fees paid to foreign related parties are deductible only with a signed fee letter, actual performance and arm's length documentation; otherwise re-add in reconciliation lines 330/331

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward utilisation and tax credits (CIR, CII, withholding tax credits)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach annex form 2058-FC; loss offset limited to €1,000,000 plus 50% of excess taxable income; non-resident shareholders cannot use French tax credits personally

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of tax due, then 10% after 30 days and 40% upon formal notice (Art. 1728 CGI); late payment interest at 0.20% per month; €150 per missing balance sheet annex (Art. 1731 CGI); deliberate omission triggers automatic assessment and 80% penalty (Art. 1729-0 A CGI).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Pre-payment: beneficial owner must give the French paying agent a valid certificate of residence (e.g., Form 5000/5001 with apostille or country-specific). The SARL withholds at treaty rate only if the certificate is received before payment; otherwise withhold 25% and the shareholder may file a refund request (Form n°10917) with the local tax office within two years. For EU parent-subsidiary directive, 0% applies where the parent holds at least 10% for a continuous 24-month period and is actually taxed; attach Form 5002/5003 and holding audit trail.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: no domestic withholding tax for ordinary arm's length interest (Art. 125 A CGI limited to specific bearer instruments); EU Interest & Royalties Directive may apply; DTA often 0%. Royalties: domestic withholding 33.33% under Art. 182 B II CGI; effectively reduced through DTA (e.g., US-France protocol: 5%; EU Interest & Royalties Directive: 0% with 25% direct EU shareholding).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Entity threshold: annual gross receipts exceeding EUR 400 million OR total balance sheet assets exceeding EUR 400 million; CbC filing requires group consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million. Below threshold, the SARL must still maintain contemporaneous arm's length evidence upon French tax administration request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No French offshore ESR; however, substance-over-form (prééminence de la réalité sur l'apparence) and the abuse-of-law doctrine (Art. L.64 LPF) apply. A SARL performing fractional CFO and accounting services must demonstrate real staff, premises, contracts, and decision-making in France. Absent substance, the administration will disregard the entity, disallow cross-border fees and apply 80% penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of service income collected via Stripe/Wise; use of sham intercompany invoices to shift profits abroad; creation of layered shell SARLs to avoid French corporate income tax and VAT
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Up to €500,000 fine and 5 years' imprisonment (€3,000,000 and 7 years if aggravated); civil penalty of 40% (Art. 1729) or 80% (Art. 1729-0 A) on evaded CIT/VAT; loss of tax credits and late-payment interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable for tax debt (Art. 1745 CGI); personal bankruptcy (faillite personnelle) where the company was a sham; court may impose up to 15 years ban on managing French companies and a travel ban.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SARL as a conduit for non-resident principals with no genuine operations in France; failure to hold general meetings or file financial statements; serving only as an invoicing device for artificial tax advantage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Dissolution of the SARL under Art. 1844-7 French Civil Code; tax recharacterisation and 80% penalty; penal exposure for false declarations of accounts (up to €15,000 for natural persons / €75,000 for legal persons)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Judicial piercing of the corporate veil due to asset commingling (confusion des patrimoines) or bad management (faute de gestion); directors liable for company debts without limitation (action en comblement du passif); travel bans and imprisonment possible for misuse of corporate assets (abus de biens sociaux: up to 5 years and €375,000).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing payments for clients without adequate KYC/AML controls; failure to identify ultimate beneficial owners; omission to report suspicious transactions to Tracfin while operating a virtual CFO service
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACPR administrative fines up to €5,000,000 (or 5% of turnover) for AML compliance failures; criminal money laundering offense under Art. 324-1 French Criminal Code: up to 5 years' imprisonment and €375,000 fine (10 years/€750,000 if habitual or organised)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be charged as accomplices if they knew or should have known of laundering; civil confiscation of bank account balances; travel prohibition; personal criminal liability; professional revocation of the accounting firm and disqualification of the directors from carrying on regulated accounting activities.
